name: [⛏️] +1 Dig Per Step
desc:
Welcome to +1 Dig Per Step! ⛏️

How to Play:
🕳️ Every step digs the ground deeper!
🏆 Reach the bottom and earn wins!
⛏️ Upgrade your pickaxe to dig faster and stronger!
💪 Train your muscles to become unstoppable!
🔥 Rebirth to unlock better multipliers!

If you’re having fun, don’t forget to like the game! 👍
